New Developments in Nancy Guthrie Abduction Case Emerge

The abduction of Nancy Guthrie, mother of a prominent US journalist, has seen new developments following an anonymous email sent to TMZ. This email claims a hidden phone contains crucial video evidence and requests Bitcoin in exchange. The FBI has been notified, and this comes days after investigators concluded a previous ransom note, which claimed Guthrie had died, originated from her abductors. The lack of a breakthrough in the case, despite significant public attention, has been noted.
